title.value: Question Personalization in an Intelligent Tutoring System
title.justification: The title was directly extracted from the beginning of the paper, reflecting its main focus on question personalization within an intelligent tutoring system.
title.quote: Question Personalization in an Intelligent Tutoring System

extractions.description: This paper investigates personalization in intelligent tutoring systems by exploring the impact of personalized question phrasing on student learning outcomes. Using a dialogue-based intelligent tutoring system, the authors test different variants of questions tailored for students' proficiency levels. Through an experimental A/B test, they demonstrate that personalized questions improve learning gains, particularly for beginners.
